---
title: "STAT 01511 9/21 Activity"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

df <- read.csv("https://manctsui.github.io/datasets/timesData.csv")
head(df)
```

```{r}

df |>
  filter(university_name == 'University of Pennsylvania') |>
  select('world_rank')
```

```{r}
#| layout-ncol: 2


UPenn <- filter(df, university_name == 'University of Pennsylvania')
ggplot(UPenn, mapping = aes(x = year, y = world_rank)) + geom_point()

UCB <- filter(df, university_name == 'University of California, Berkeley')
ggplot(UCB, mapping = aes(x = year, y = world_rank)) + geom_point()
```
